queries.item: UPDATE ?:payments p LEFT JOIN ?:payment_processors pp ON pp.processor_id = p.processor_id JOIN ?:payment_processors netopia ON netopia.processor_script = 'netopia_payments.php' SET p.processor_id = netopia.processor_id WHERE pp.processor_id IS NULL AND p.processor_params LIKE '%pos_signature%';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:netopia_refund_attempts ( request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, order_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL, ntp_id VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL, status ENUM('pending','succeeded','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', error VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL, created_at INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, completed_at INT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (request_id), INDEX idx_order (order_id, created_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
